versions.label: Minecraft version
versions.showExperimental: Show snapshots, old alpha & old beta

library.empty: No instances yet. Create one to get started.
library.needAccount: Sign in or choose offline mode to play

instances.importChooseFileHint: Pick a .mrpack or CurseForge modpack zip to import.
instances.loaderHint: Pick what this instance runs on: plain vanilla, or a mod loader.
instances.settingsIntro: Rename this instance, tune how it launches, or remove it.
instances.jvmArgsHint: Added on top of Settings → Minecraft's own default arguments, if any. Don't set memory here. Use the Memory section instead.
instances.javaProbeFailed: Couldn't run this. Check the path.
instances.javaMismatch: This is Java {actual}, but this version needs Java {required}. It won't be able to launch.
instances.skipJavaCheckHint: Launch even if this Java version doesn't match what's required. Can crash or corrupt saves.
instances.minMemoryHint: Minimum reserves memory upfront to reduce stutter. Most players can leave it low.
instances.memoryTooLow: Minimum memory can't be higher than maximum.
instances.memoryOverride: Use custom memory for this instance
instances.memoryInherited: Using the global default: {max} GB maximum, {min} GB minimum. Change it in Settings → Minecraft → Memory.
instances.windowOverride: Use a custom size for this instance
instances.windowInherited: Using the global default: {size}. Change it in Settings → Minecraft → Window.
instances.consoleHint: Strata has no separate console window. This opens its own Logs page instead.
instances.quickPlayNoWorlds: This instance has no worlds yet.
instances.quickPlayUnsupported: Joining on launch needs Minecraft 1.20 or later.
instances.commandsHint: Runs after Settings → Minecraft's own commands. $INST_NAME, $INST_ID, $INST_DIR, $INST_JAVA, and $INST_JAVA_ARGS are available in pre-launch and post-exit commands.
instances.wrapperHint: Runs java through this program instead of launching it directly. No variables here, just a program name.
instances.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently removes its saves and settings. There's no undoing it.

version.intro: Choose the mod loader and Minecraft version for this instance.
version.loaderHint: Switching loaders re-downloads what that loader needs the first time.
version.noInstance: Create or select an instance first.
version.backupNotice: Your worlds will be backed up automatically before this change.
version.componentsHint: The real version-pinned pieces behind your current loader and Minecraft version choice.
version.coremodsHint: Replace this instance's client jar for old total-conversion mods (like BTA) that patch Minecraft directly instead of using a mod loader.

content.needsLoader: Mods require a mod loader. Switch to Fabric or Quilt on the Version screen first.

intro.mod: Mods installed in the current instance.
intro.resourcepack: Resource packs installed in the current instance.
intro.shader: Shader packs installed in the current instance.

content.curseforgeUnavailableHint: Needs a CurseForge API key, not set up yet.
content.differentVersionHint: This is different from the instance's own version, content installed here may not work.

worlds.intro: Saves that belong to the current instance.
worlds.empty: No worlds yet. Create one from Play to see it here.

servers.intro: Multiplayer servers saved from the current instance's own server list.
servers.empty: No servers yet. Add one from the in-game Multiplayer screen to see it here.

screenshots.empty: No screenshots yet. Press F2 in game to take one.

settings.densityHint: Tighter spacing in the sidebar, content lists, and Worlds/Screenshots grids.
settings.sidebarPersistentHint: Off by default: the sidebar shows icons only and expands while you hover over it.
settings.updatesHint: Strata can check GitHub for new releases and install them in place.
settings.storageHint: Choose where Strata keeps its data, instances, and downloads.
settings.storagePendingLabel: Queued: moving to {path} on next start.
settings.storageRestartHint: Strata restarts automatically to move everything to the new folder.
settings.storageRestartingNotice: Restarting Strata to move your data…
settings.globalWindowHint: The default for instances that don't set their own size.
settings.globalMemoryHint: The default for instances that don't set their own memory.
settings.globalJvmArgsHint: Added to every launch, on top of what each instance sets.
settings.launcherCloseOnLaunch: Close Strata once the game starts
settings.launcherQuitOnExit: Quit Strata once the game closes
settings.launcherCloseOnLaunchHint: Post-exit commands and crash tracking won't run for this session, since Strata itself closes first.
settings.launcherHideToTrayHint: Strata reappears once the game closes, or any time from the tray icon.
settings.logUploadTargetHint: Where the Logs page's Upload button sends a log. Pastebin only appears once configured.
settings.skipJavaCheckDefault: Skip Java compatibility check by default
settings.skipJavaCheckDefaultHint: Applied to new instances only. Each can still change it afterward.
settings.runtimesHint: Strata's own auto-managed Java installs. Deleting one just means the next launch that needs it downloads it again.
settings.globalCommandsHint: Real shell commands, run locally, before each instance's own.
settings.updateError: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
settings.disclosureLine1: Strata Launcher is not an official Minecraft product. It is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
settings.disclosureLine2: All sign-in, skins, capes, and account data are handled directly by Mojang and Microsoft. Strata runs no servers of its own and never stores your data anywhere but your own device.

wizard.welcomeBody: Let's get you set up: sign in, then we'll check for anything to bring over from another launcher.
wizard.importBody: We can bring over instances you already have: mods, saves, and all.

skin.offlineNote: Uploading a custom skin and picking a cape need a Microsoft account. You'll keep this default look until you sign in.
skin.badDimensions: That image isn't a valid skin size. It needs to be 64×64 (or legacy 64×32) pixels.
skin.badFile: Couldn't read that file as an image.
skin.capesHint: Pick from capes already on your account. Mojang doesn't allow uploading custom capes.
skin.capesTryOnHint: Preview only. These aren't sent to Mojang since you don't actually own them.
skin.noCapes: This account doesn't have any capes.

login.title: Sign in to Strata
login.msDescription: Sign in with your Microsoft account to play with your real Minecraft profile.
login.enterCode: Go to {url} and enter this code:
login.waitingForSignIn: Waiting for you to finish signing in…
login.offlineDescription: Play without signing in: a legitimate local/LAN testing mode, not an ownership bypass.
